links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to erectile dysfunction questions (FKGL, GFS, FRES)
links.effect: FKGL 16.5 (IQR 1.9) DeepSeek vs 17.9 (IQR 2.7) ChatGPT, p=0.034; GFS 18.8 vs 20.6, p=0.016; FRES negative for both, no significant difference (p=0.140). Grade levels far above plain language.
links.quote: While no significant difference was observed in FRES (-5.7 (IQR 17.5) vs. -10.1 (IQR 17.7), p = 0.140), both FKGL ( 16.5 (IQR 1.9) vs. 17.9 (IQR 2.7), p = 0.034) and GFS (18.8 (IQR 4.9) vs.20.6 (IQR 5.8), p = 0.016) scores were significantly lower for DeepSeek-V3, indicating superior readability.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of accuracy and readability of responses from ChatGPT-4o and DeepSeek V3 to common patient questions regarding erectile dysfunction, evaluated by expert urologists.
